A. Award Bid #4494 and Authorize Agreement with Woods Maintenance Services, Inc. dba Graffiti Control Systems for Citywide Graffiti Removal Services
Recommended Action
Staff recommends that the City Council:
1. Adopt a finding of categorical exemptions pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) (Common Sense Exemption) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) guidelines ;
2. Award Bid #4494 to Woods Maintenance Services, Inc. dba Graffiti Control Systems for graffiti removal services for the Public Works Department ; and
3. Authorize the City Manager to negotiate and execute an agreement with Woods Maintenance Services, Inc. dba Graffiti Control Systems , in an amount not to exceed $697,320 for five years, with future year funding contingent on Council budget approval .

3. Authorize the Procurement Manager to issue a purchase order with DeltaGreen Products for the purchase of heavy duty cleaner and degreaser in an amount not to exceed $1 2 3 ,000 for one year, with two additional two-year renewal options, for a total amount not to exceed $ 6 1 5 , 000 over a five-year period, with future year funding contingent on Council budget approval .

Recommended Action

2. Award RFP #SP2307-2025 to Archi.txture , LLC dba BASK to provide Steelcase systems furniture procurement, installation, and consulting services citywide on an as-needed basis ; and

D. Award RFP SP2539 and Agreements to PSOMAS and KDM Meridian for On-Call Surveying Services
R ecommended Action
Staff recommends that the City Council:
1. Adopt a finding of exemption pursuant to Section 15262 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines ;
2. Award RFP #SP2539 to PSOMAS and KDM Meridian to provide on-call surveying services for the Public Works Department; and
3. Authorize the City Manager to negotiate and execute agreements for on-call surveying services with PSOMAS and KDM Meridian, in an amount not to exceed $ 250 ,000 for each agreement, over a five-year period, with one ( 1) five-year renewal option under the same terms and conditions as the original period. Prior to the end of the initial term, staff will present the extended term to the City Council for ratification

G. Introduction and First Reading of an Ordinance Prohibiting Sale and Use of Algorithmic Devices to Set Residential Rental Prices
Recommended Action:
Staff recommends that the City Council
1. Adopt a finding of no possibility of significant effect pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) (Common Sense Exemption) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines; and
2. Introduce for first reading the attached Ordinance amending the text of the Santa Monica Municipal Code by adding Chapter 4.58 Algorithmic Rental Price Fixing .

2. Review and provide direction to staff on the FY 2025-27 Proposed Biennial Budget, including the FY 2025-26 Proposed Exception-Based Capital Improvement Program (CIP) Budget (Attachment A);
3. Review and provide direction to staff on proposed changes to the City’s Fees and Fines (Attachment E);
4. Provide direction to staff on revising the Council Travel Funds policy;
5. Direct staff to procee d with setting the FY 2025-27 Budget Adoption public hearing on June 24, 2025 .
